_comment: E2 second validation block (docs/preregistration_e2.md execution note 3): random_order[120:200] of the same fixed order (seed 2027-e2). Block size 80: need 121 - 79 = 42 more usable; usable rate of block 1 = 79/120; Binomial(80, 0.66) gives >= 42 with probability ~0.995. Validating more than needed changes nothing (only the first 121 activated usable tasks in the random order are used).

harness._comment: SWE-bench-Live (Python) is scored with its own harness fork (python-only branch, pinned) and its prebuilt images, per its README: run_evaluation --dataset_name SWE-bench-Live/SWE-bench-Live --split full --namespace starryzhang
